own.title: Your numbers
own.note: The archive records for each message which number it went from; a reply from the browser is sent by the phone that has the conversation's number.

groups.title: Groups with their own number
groups.note: People in a group always get SMS from the chosen number — in the conversation, in a new message and in a reply from a notification. In a conversation you can change it in its header (it then applies only to that conversation).
groups.oneSim: This phone has one number — choosing a number for groups appears with two SIM cards.
groups.empty: No groups yet. Create the first one — or enter a group on a contact (Contacts → person → Groups).

edit.noComma: A group name cannot contain a comma.

edit.name: Group name
edit.sendFrom: Send SMS to these people from the number
